summary: Massive interactive Chinese menu system (~500 lines) added alongside existing CLI commands (cmd_add_key, cmd_remove_key, cmd_list_keys kept for compat) — two parallel implementations
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: Dual maintenance burden; menu logic duplicated across _provider_key_menu (lines 796-898) and second _provider_key_menu (lines 1121-1171); any bug fix must be applied twice; CLI tests don't cover interactive paths; Chinese-only UI limits accessibility

Complexity cost: Five functions defined twice; diverging implementations (e.g., _prompt_secret uses different trap/stty logic); future changes risk updating only one copy; violates DRY in ~500-line file

summary: Temp file argument parsing replaces eval — introduces mktemp, trap, file I/O, and while-read-loop for simple positional parsing
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: 60 lines vs ~20 for eval approach; temp file cleanup on EXIT/INT/TERM; race condition window (mktemp name collision); unnecessary for shell positional parsing which can be done with array-style shift loop; eval risk was only for --model=value with quotes, fixable with case on $1

summary: _write_kv rewritten from sed to awk — awk version is 11 lines vs sed's 12, but awk adds BEGIN/END blocks and temp file dance for a simple line replacement
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: awk script harder to audit for shell injection (var/val passed via -v); sed version used unlikely delimiter (\036) and was portable; awk version may misbehave with newlines in values; no measurable simplification

summary: buildCandidates now handles plus-first ordering with dual loops — plusKeys @ plusUrl first, then keypool @ apiUrl, adding branching for CR_PLUS_KEYS/CR_PLUS_URL
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: Two separate loops with duplicated candidate object construction; plusUrl fallback to apiUrl adds silent behavior; callers (bin/crouter build_all_routes) must now compute and pass _plus_pool; single array concat would be simpler: candidates = plusKeys.map(...) + keypool.map(...);

summary: Per-request retry counter passed as parameter to attempt() instead of using closure over remaining — remaining threaded through 4 call sites
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: remaining passed through attempt(i, req, res, body, remaining) → 4 recursive calls; closure (let remaining = MAX_RETRY inside handler) would capture per-request state automatically; parameter threading adds visual noise and error surface (wrong value passed)

summary: Provider file adds commented-out keypool config (AUTH_MODE, AUTH_KEYS, PLUS_URL, PLUS_KEYS) alongside active env-mode config — dead code in source
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: Commented config creates drift risk (user uncomments wrong lines); AUTH_MODE="env" active but keypool example shows AUTH_MODE="keypool" — mutually exclusive; should be in README only

summary: PLUS_URL/PLUS_KEYS uncommented (were commented placeholders) but no keys configured — adds config surface without data
failure_scenario: Complexity cost: PLUS_KEYS="moonshot-coding-2" references non-existent Keychain entry; gateway will try plus surface first (via route-build.js plus-first logic) and fail; creates false impression of dual-surface support
